decisive_items: compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery
Doppler ultrasonography of the left lower extremity demonstrated extensive deep vein thrombosis
response.rationale: May-Thurner Syndrome is the most likely diagnosis due to the compression of the left common iliac vein, which is a characteristic finding of this condition. While Deep Vein Thrombosis is also present, it is more of a symptom than a primary diagnosis in this case.

rejected.why: Negative test results for antiphospholipid antibodies make Antiphospholipid Syndrome unlikely
